picks.title: Introducing Agent-Native Beta: The Framework for Agentic Apps
picks.excerpt: Builder.io released Agent-Native, an open-source TypeScript framework for building AI agents with rich UIs: define an action once and use it in the UI, the agent, the API, the CLI and MCP.
picks.rationale: New open-source release: one action definition drives UI, agent, API and MCP, a concrete pattern for designing agentic product UIs.

picks.title: Spectral Labs builds 'Turing Test for AI CAD'
picks.excerpt: Spectral Labs claims to have built the first AI system to pass an industry-standard CAD certification for mechanical engineers, a SolidWorks exam.
picks.rationale: Novel milestone claim: an AI passing a SolidWorks certification exam sets a measurable bar for text-to-CAD capability.

picks.title: Sparseal releases CozyBlanket Pro
picks.excerpt: Sparseal's much-anticipated AI-assisted retopology, UV unwrapping and baking app CozyBlanket Pro is now available for iPad, with a desktop edition in development.
picks.rationale: Shipping release: AI-assisted retopology, UVs and baking on iPad, a hands-on tool 3D artists can use tomorrow.

picks.title: Workday launches Sana-based UI, autopilot agents, as it deepens its focus on AI
picks.excerpt: Workday is replacing its interface with a Sana-based agent UI. Autonomous agents keep running while users are offline and tell them what they missed when they sign in, and customers can even go headless.
picks.rationale: A major enterprise app swapping its screen UI for an agent UI (with a headless option) is a concrete signal for product designers of agentic software.

picks.title: AI is hollowing out the middle of design, leaving an hourglass behind
picks.excerpt: For fifteen years the design process kept growing while the time left for making the product kept shrinking; the essay argues AI is now compressing the middle of that process into an hourglass shape.
picks.rationale: Swap-in replacement: a designer-facing argument about where AI compresses the design process (the middle) and where human work concentrates (the ends), useful for planning team process even though it is an essay, not a release.

alternates.title: Epic thinks you'll love its new vibe coded game launcher
alternates.rationale: Games-adjacent commentary; already a games pick today (cross-section clash).
